language: JavaScript (Node.js 20+ / 原生浏览器 ES modules)

workflow_checks.command: node --input-type=module -e 'import {compose} from "./server/sheet/compose.mjs"; import {demo} from "./server/terrain/demo.mjs"; const a=compose({grid:demo()}); if(a.faces<=0||a.faces>=2*27*21)process.exit(1); console.log(a.faces);'

node --input-type=module -e 'import {compose} from "./server/sheet/compose.mjs"; import {demo} from "./server/terrain/demo.mjs"; const a=compose({grid:{width:2,height:2,unit:1,elevations:[0,10,10,20]},interval:5}); if(!a.levels.some(x=>x.height===10&&x.paths===1))process.exit(1); console.log(a.levels);'

node --input-type=module -e 'import {compose} from "./server/sheet/compose.mjs"; import {demo} from "./server/terrain/demo.mjs"; const a=compose({grid:demo(),bounds:{left:40,bottom:40,right:450,top:370}}); if(!a.svg.includes('"'"'viewBox="0 0 410 330"'"'"'))process.exit(1); console.log(a.bounds);'

node --input-type=module -e 'import {compose} from "./server/sheet/compose.mjs"; import {demo} from "./server/terrain/demo.mjs"; const a=compose({grid:demo(),section:{x1:0,y1:140,x2:540,y2:140,count:61}}); if(a.profile.length!==61||!a.profile.some(p=>p.z===null)||a.profile.at(-1).distance!==540)process.exit(1); console.log(a.section.length);'

node --input-type=module -e 'import {compose} from "./server/sheet/compose.mjs"; import {demo} from "./server/terrain/demo.mjs"; const data={grid:demo()}; const a=compose(data); if(!a.svg.includes("data-elevation")||a.svg!==compose(data).svg)process.exit(1); console.log(a.svg.length);'
